# Full removal-threshold sweep: four losses, final epoch 20

All models completed 2,000 updates on the same 35 A findings. B contains 34 findings excluded from gradients; it is repeatedly inspected development data. Full combines both. Status remains **pending_user_review**.

**All 201 thresholds are listed below**, from 0.000 to 1.000 in 0.005 steps, in fixed arm order. Scores are mean per-finding Dice, rounded to six decimals here; CSV/JSON retain stored precision.

Delete a base-positive voxel only when its removal probability is **strictly greater than** the listed threshold. Lower thresholds delete more. The frozen base prediction always uses probability threshold 0.5, so its reference is constant. Removal threshold 1.000 reproduces the baseline exactly. Thresholds do not enter training.

| Column | Objective |
| --- | --- |
| BCE TP2 | F + 2K (historical control) |
| BCE TP1 | F + K |
| Dice + BCE TP2 | D + 0.25(F + 2K)/3 |
| Dice + BCE TP1 | D + 0.25(F + K)/2 |

F and K are the separate FP-deletion and TP-preservation BCE means. D is the finding-aware patch Dice surrogate. Dice arms also rescale BCE. No threshold, checkpoint or model is automatically selected.
